title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 9: Ghosts

scenes.say: Every night, Roddy is in the passenger seat.
scenes.visual: an empty passenger seat in a car at night, dashboard glow, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Every night, the flash. Every night, the ringing.
scenes.visual: a white flash dissolving into a dark bedroom, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He stops sleeping. Then he stops answering the phone.
scenes.visual: a phone buzzing face down on a nightstand, unanswered, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Old friends from the block offer him the old medicine.
scenes.visual: a hand offering a bottle in a dark hallway, faces unseen, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: For a minute, the street almost takes him back.
scenes.visual: a man standing at the edge of a dim alley, looking in, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Then he sees a kid watching him. Same age he was in that Cutlass.
scenes.visual: a young boy on a bike watching from across a street, evening, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali walks away from the alley.
scenes.visual: a man walking away from an alley toward a lit main street, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He sits in his car outside the VA for an hour before he goes in.
scenes.visual: a car parked outside a veterans affairs building, engine off, morning, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Asking for help feels like losing. It's the bravest thing he's ever done.
scenes.visual: a man's hand pushing open a glass door marked with an American flag, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He says Roddy's name out loud to a stranger. And he breaks.
scenes.visual: a man sitting across from a counselor, seen from behind, soft window light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Ten. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: morning light filling an empty hallway, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 9 of 25: Ghosts. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
